review_candidates.title: English Specialist
review_candidates.description: Description TCF is starting development for grade 6-8 resources. The English Specialist is required to develop and review high-quality English language teaching and learning resources for these grades. The role will involve writing of chapters, lesson plans, including audio-visual materials and technology-enabled learning solutions, story boarding and working with graphic designers. Other responsibilities of the role include developing and reviewing curriculum content, syllabus plans, assessments, conduct relevant research, review and evaluate resources, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that materials are pedagogically sound, engaging, age-appropriate, and aligned with intended learning outcomes. Job Responsibilities: Develop and review Secondary English curriculum materials, including learning outcomes, syllabus plans, scope and sequence, and curriculum documents. Research and develop concepts for chapters and units, using relevant learner needs, curriculum requirements, EFL practices and available evidence to inform content and learning experiences. Write and review English learning content, including chapters, lessons, activities, examples, exercises and supporting materials, ensuring they are accurate, age-appropriate and aligned with learning outcomes. Develop and review lesson plans and Teacher Guides, providing clear teaching steps, pedagogical guidance, differentiation and classroom support. Develop storyboards and content briefs for audio-visual and technology-enabled learning resources, and work with graphic designers and other specialists to develop the final resources. Identify, adapt and develop supplementary learning resources, including audio-visual materials, digital activities and other tools that enhance student engagement and learning. Conduct and apply research on English language teaching, learning, assessment and resource development to inform content decisions and improve concepts and materials. Evaluate existing curriculum materials and resources using research, user feedback and implementation evidence, and recommend specific improvements. Collaborate with curriculum, assessment, teacher training, research, design and technology teams to ensure resources are pedagogically sound, engaging, consistent and fit for purpose. Participate in classroom observations, school visits and other field activities to gather insights that inform curriculum and resource development. Prepare project documentation and manage assigned deliverables, including content plans, reports and presentations, ensuring quality, consistency and timely completion. Review English assessment papers and other assessment materials to ensure that they are appropriate, accurate and aligned with the intended learning outcomes. Required Skills Good knowledge of English language instruction approaches, particularly for EFL based on CEFR. Understanding of teaching methods, learning approaches and assessment practices for English. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Demonstrate design thinking and the ability to create clear, age-appropriate Secondary learning content and resources that foster meaningful student engagement and joyful learning. Ability to review and enhance curriculum and teaching materials through constructive feedback and collaboration. Ability to research, analyse and organise relevant information to inform improvements. Good planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage deadlines. Ability to collaborate with different teams and stakeholders. Good digital proficiency, with working knowledge of Microsoft Office (particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint), AI chatbots, and relevant digital applications and tools. Education Bachelor’s degree (preferably English Language, Literature or Linguistics). English language teaching qualifications such as TEFL or TESOL will be an advantage. Experience 2-3 years in Secondary (age 11-15 Y) English Language teaching, training or curriculum development. Experience in developing or reviewing teaching and learning materials will be an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Counter Manager
review_candidates.description: Role Description The Counter Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations and commercial performance of a retail counter, ensuring customers receive a professional, engaging, and consistent service experience. The role combines team leadership, sales management, customer engagement, merchandising, stock coordination, and operational administration to support the overall performance of the counter. The position is responsible for setting daily priorities, coordinating counter activities, monitoring sales performance, and ensuring that service standards are consistently maintained. The Counter Manager works closely with team members to create a welcoming environment, understand customer needs, provide appropriate product guidance, and support the achievement of sales and service objectives. Key responsibilities include monitoring daily sales, reviewing performance against targets, identifying opportunities to improve results, and supporting promotional or seasonal campaigns. The role may also contribute to sales planning, product launches, customer engagement initiatives, and strategies designed to increase customer retention and overall counter performance. Team leadership is an important part of the position. The Counter Manager coordinates schedules, assigns responsibilities, supports team development, and promotes a positive and professional working environment. The role provides guidance on customer service, product presentation, sales techniques, and operational procedures while addressing day-to-day issues efficiently. The position is also responsible for maintaining high standards of visual presentation and merchandising. This includes ensuring products are displayed appropriately, promotional materials are current, the counter remains organised, and brand standards are consistently represented. Stock and operational control are another key area of responsibility. The Counter Manager monitors inventory levels, coordinates replenishment, checks product availability, and works with relevant teams to minimise stock discrepancies or operational disruptions. Accurate records and appropriate handling of sales and administrative information are expected. The role requires regular communication with store management, retail teams, brand representatives, suppliers, and other stakeholders where appropriate. The Counter Manager may prepare sales reports, operational updates, and performance summaries to support management decisions. Above all, the role represents the brand directly to customers and is expected to demonstrate professionalism, product knowledge, commercial awareness, and a strong commitment to delivering an excellent customer experience. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Business, Retail Management, Marketing, Sales, or a related field is preferred. Strong understanding of retail operations, customer service, sales processes, and commercial performance. Ability to lead and coordinate a team while maintaining high service and operational standards. Strong customer engagement and interpersonal communication skills. Confident approach to sales, product presentation, upselling, and customer relationship management. Ability to monitor sales performance, interpret basic commercial data, and identify opportunities for improvement. Good understanding of merchandising, promotional activities, product launches, and retail presentation standards. Strong organisational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Ability to handle customer concerns professionally and resolve day-to-day operational issues efficiently. Good understanding of stock management, inventory monitoring, replenishment, and basic administrative procedures. Strong attention to detail when handling sales records, product information, reports, and operational documentation. Comfortable using Microsoft Office, point-of-sale systems, inventory platforms, and other retail management tools. Professional appearance, confident communication style, and a customer-focused mindset. Ability to work collaboratively with store teams, brand representatives, suppliers, and management. Strong commercial awareness with a proactive approach to achieving business and customer-service objectives. High level of professionalism, accountability, reliability, and integrity.

review_candidates.description: Job Description - Software DeveloperAbout The Company Rubicon Consulting is a leading talent management consultancy dedicated to helping organizations optimize their business performance and gain a competitive edge through strategic talent acquisition and workforce solutions. With a proven track record of connecting top-tier professionals with innovative companies, Rubicon Consulting prides itself on delivering tailored recruitment services that meet the unique needs of each client. Our expertise spans various industries, including technology, telecommunications, finance, and more, ensuring that our clients have access to the best talent in the market. We are committed to fostering long-term partnerships, providing exceptional service, and maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in all our endeavors. About The Role We are currently seeking a highly skilled Software Developer with a focus on voice services to join our dynamic team on a 4+ year contract based in Suffolk. This role involves building, maintaining, and optimizing next-generation communication platforms that integrate traditional telecommunication protocols with modern cloud-based artificial intelligence technologies. The successful candidate will serve as a bridge between legacy telephony systems and cutting-edge cloud solutions, ensuring seamless voice communication experiences across multiple platforms. Your core responsibilities will include developing robust SIP services using Java, managing open-source media engines, and integrating advanced Speech AI technologies into multi-cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on innovative projects that shape the future of voice communication technology. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in Java programming, with extensive experience in multi-threading and network application development. A deep understanding of Java and related frameworks such as JAIN SLEE and SIP Servlets is essential. Hands-on experience configuring and scripting with telephony engines like FreeSWITCH or Asterisk is required, along with a solid grasp of voice protocols including SIP, RTP/RTCP, and SDP. Familiarity with integrating cloud speech APIs such as AWS Transcribe/Polly, Azure Speech, and Google Cloud Speech-to-Text is highly desirable. Candidates should have experience deploying and managing applications across multi-cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP. Proficiency with VoIP troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark or sngrep is also necessary. Preferred qualifications include experience with Java telephony frameworks like Metaswitch Rhino SLEE or Oracle OCCAS, knowledge of containerization using Docker and Kubernetes, and understanding of WebRTC and telephony security standards like TLS and SRTP. Responsibilities Develop, test, and maintain high-performance SIP-based voice services utilizing Java frameworks such as JAIN SLEE and SIP Servlets to ensure reliable and scalable communication channels. Configure, manage, and optimize open-source media servers like FreeSWITCH or Asterisk to facilitate voice call routing and media handling. Integrate Speech AI components including Speech-to-Text (STT), Text-to-Speech (TTS), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) workflows into live voice streams to enhance user interaction and automation capabilities. Deploy voice applications across multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform, ensuring high availability and performance monitoring. Utilize network analysis tools such as Wireshark or sngrep to diagnose and troubleshoot audio quality issues, call drops, and latency problems, maintaining optimal service quality. Collaborate closely with senior architects and DevOps teams to develop and deploy scalable conversational AI bots and voice solutions that meet client specifications. Participate in code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the robustness and security of voice communication systems. Benefits Rubicon Consulting offers a competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being and professional growth. This includes comprehensive health insurance, retirement plan options, and paid time off. Employees will have access to ongoing training and development opportunities to stay current with the latest industry technologies. The company fosters a collaborative and innovative work environment, encouraging continuous learning and career advancement. Additionally, flexible working arrangements may be available to accommodate individual needs, along with support for work-life balance. Being part of Rubicon Consulting means contributing to impactful projects in a forward-thinking organization committed to excellence and innovation. Equal Opportunity Rubicon Consulting is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse teams lead to better ideas, innovation, and success, and we are dedicated to fostering an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared goals.

review_candidates.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Focused)
review_candidates.location: San José, San Jose, Costa Rica
review_candidates.description: Company Description We are Software Mind, an awesome team of engineers who are ready to ramp up any top-notch company’s projects! Our aim? To always be one step ahead. Become part of a multicultural company in constant growth with an excellent work environment certified by Great Place To Work! Overview Job Description Software Mind is seeking qualified candidates to fill the role of Senior Backend / Data Engineer . In Addition To a Competitive Salary Rate And a Positive Work Environment, We Are Committed To Delivering High-quality Technology Solutions. We Also Offer Flexible schedules and authentic work-life balance Opportunities for continuing education Birthday celebration Payment in US Dollars About The Role We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend focused) to help design, build, and operate scalable backend systems that support core business workflows and data-driven products. This is a primarily backend-focused role (~70%) , with a smaller front-end component (~30%) working within an HTML/HTMX-based stack . Deep front-end expertise is not required, but candidates should be comfortable picking up front-end development when needed. The role combines hands-on development with ownership of critical services and collaboration across product, data, and operations teams. You will contribute to system architecture, code quality, reliability, and the continuous improvement of engineering practices. You will work hands-on with technologies including Python, SQL, AWS, PostgreSQL/MySQL, Snowflake, Docker, Kubernetes, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and microservices architecture . The environment also includes data pipelines and orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow. Some Of The Main Responsibilities For The Role Include Design and implement reliable, scalable backend services and data pipelines. Develop and maintain backend applications primarily using Python and SQL. Drive engineering best practices around testing, code quality, performance, security, and maintainability. Improve system observability and participate in diagnosing and resolving production issues. Build and maintain data ingestion services using APIs and batch file processing. Modernize legacy workflows by replacing manual or spreadsheet-driven processes with automated and resilient systems. Develop internal dashboards and services that provide real-time operational and business visibility. Create automation to reduce manual investigation and enable self-service for internal stakeholders. Improve monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks across backend pipelines. Collaborate with product, analytics, and operations teams to align technical solutions with business needs. Contribute to technical direction, architecture decisions, and roadmap planning. Contribute to the application's front-end layer (~30% of the role) using technologies such as HTML, HTMX, Jinja templates, and Python-based rendering. Qualifications Job Skills/Requirements +90% English written and oral (at least B2-C1 level) with excellent communication skills. 5+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in backend development. Strong backend engineering background with the ability to deliver pragmatic and iterative technical solutions. Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments while maintaining high engineering standards. Ability to independently own technical work and lead technical efforts across teams. Willingness to take ownership, learn from failures, and continuously improve systems and processes Technical Skills Backend / Programming Strong proficiency in Python Strong proficiency in SQL Experience designing and developing production backend services Databases & Data Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and/or MySQL, with PostgreSQL preferred Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse Experience working with data ingestion, processing, and data-driven applications Cloud Experience deploying and managing applications on AWS DevOps Experience with technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS CDK, or similar tools Familiarity with CI/CD practices and production deployments Architecture Experience designing scalable, reliable, high-performance distributed systems Strong understanding of microservices architecture Strong API design experience, including REST APIs and/or GraphQL Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and secure service design Experience with unit and integration testing Front-End (Highly Desired) HTML HTMX Jinja templates Using Python for front-end/server-rendered application development Deep expertise in a traditional JavaScript frontend framework is not required . Additional Information Nice To Have Skills (not Required) Experience with Apache Airflow or another data pipeline/orchestration platform Experience with frontend frameworks or languages such as React, Next.js, Angular, or JavaScript
